lines.trans: Thank you. Sorry that I bothered you.
My sister is unreachable, and it is scary to go to the store alone.
Call at any time! Alright, I will go.
I have work in three hours.
Well, wait. Will you make it home?
Stay! Here is a mattress.
Max, why are you here?
Well I brought canned stewed meat.
Did you forget? Your divorce is the day after tomorrow!
You know what, you had better spend the night at home.
